newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Senate moves Monday on Justice's Klein.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Senate moves Monday on Justice's Klein.

text.p: The Senate will vote Monday on a request to limit debate on the nomination of Joel Klein to be assistant attorney general in charge of the antitrust division.

Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said the cloture vote will occur at 1800 EDT (2200 GMT). If the Senate agreed to limit debate, another three hours of discussion could occur Monday or at a later time before a final vote.
Democratic Sen. Ernest Hollings of South Carolina has fought approval of Klein due to his decisions on telecommunications industry mergers.
